title: Backup Administrator
description:
**Experience- 8-10 years**

**Role & Responsibilities**

• Lead a team of Backup & Recovery Administrators and provide 24x7 Production Support.

• Handle escalated incidents and critical tickets.

• Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues escalated from L1/L2 support teams.

• Anticipate and Predict Risks/Impact on Production Environment and handle Major Changes.

• Manage and Report Performance Dashboards with Capacity Planning.

• Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions for recurring problems.

• Collaborate with Cohesity engineering and product teams for bug fixes and enhancements.

• Monitor system performance and proactively identify potential issues.

• Maintain detailed documentation of issues, resolutions, and best practices.

• Participate in on-call rotation for critical incident support.

• Ensure compliance with banking industry standards and security protocols.

• Design, Migration and upgradation of existing Backup Infrastructure.

• Provide advanced technical support for Cohesity products including backup, recovery, and data management solutions.

• Create suggested target backup schedules and operational plans.

• Design Media retention plans and media management process.

• Ensure all backup jobs are scheduled appropriately and expediently.

• Prepare Backup reports from the existing tools.

• Agent Installation and configuration of backups of FS, DB (Oracle, MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB), AD, Exchange)

**Job Requirements/Descriptions)**

• Level 3 Backup & Recovery SME and Administrator.

• Good knowledge on Data duplication, deduplication and replication concepts.

• Well versed with Backup and Recovery planning and implementation.

• Media Management & Vendor Coordination.

• Troubleshooting complex problems.

• Candidate is expected to have complex production support experience.

• Backup Solution Server / Client installations.

• Patching & Upgradation.

• Advanced documentation skills.

• Recovery of Backup Server from failure.

• Change Management Planning and Implementation.

• Disaster Recovery Support (plan & participate).

• Backup tool migration.

**Technical Skills Required**

• Expert in design, configuration and implementation of Cohesity.

• Hands-on experience with Veritas NetBackup (Cohesity) platform (DataProtect, Helios, SmartFiles, etc.).

• High Availability Configurations.

• Custom Design.

• Performance Management of Backup Infrastructure.

• Tape Library configuration.

• Disk to Disk and Disk to Disk to Tape configurations.

• Recovery experience with specific backup modules like Oracle, MSSQL, MS Exchange, VMWare snapshot and SharePoint.

• Knowledge on BMR backup configuration and recovery.

• Knowledge on Cohesity replication and reporting.

• Knowledge on restoration from tape library.

• Exposure on VMWare infra

**Specific Domain/Technical/Functional skills**

• Strong troubleshooting skills in Backup Infrastructure environment and advanced problem-solving skills.

• Proactive measures and preventive measures for problems/errors.

• Management of Backup SLAs and KPIs.

• Liaise with vendors & OEMs for the technical issues / escalations.

• Drive major incidents and resolutions.

• Documentation & Operational performance reporting.

• People management and skills development.

• Own and Drive Service Improvement plans.

• Identify, own and mitigate risks.

• Ensure compliance to client and organization processes and policies.

• Perform backup performance tuning.

• Should have relevant scripting knowledge.

• Preparing scripting tools for automation.

• Exposure to mid-range & high-end servers and backup appliances.

• Exposure on clustering & High Availability.

• License Management.

• Enable and support the team in resolving day-to-day production issues, disaster recovery exercise, capacity planning and other activities as may be necessary.

• ITIL Certified preferred.

title: Manager – Lead Automation & Integration
description:
* Pre-Sales Support & Solution Engineering
* Support customer discussions and translate requirements into practical controls, software, and integration scopes.
* Prepare budgetary and detailed estimates covering PLCs, panels, field devices, safety systems, industrial networks, HMI/SCADA, software interfaces, engineering, testing, and commissioning.
* Review supplier proposals for technical completeness, compliance, exclusions, interfaces, and risks.
* Define supply boundaries and support solution architecture, controls philosophy, interface concepts, scope documents, and technical proposal inputs.
* Supplier Identification & Technical Evaluation
* Develop and maintain a capable supplier network for PLC and controls engineering, WCS/WES, conveyor and ASRS controls, AGV/AMR integration, HMI/SCADA, and industrial networking.
* Assess supplier competence, capacity, references, standards, documentation, service capability, and commercial competitiveness.
* Conduct technical bid comparisons, support negotiations, and establish reusable cost benchmarks and estimation templates.
* Controls & Software Integration Engineering
* Define and review controls and integration architecture, including PLC hardware, I/O, industrial networks, communication protocols, HMI concepts, and safety interfaces.
* Coordinate interfaces among ERP, WMS, WES, WCS, PLC systems, ASRS equipment, conveyors, cranes, shuttle systems, sortation, AGVs/AMRs, and peripheral equipment.
* Review FDS, interface specifications, I/O lists, electrical drawings, and supplier software design documents.
* Support interface mapping, data-point definition, exception handling, test-case preparation, and end-to-end validation.
* Project Execution & Implementation
* Act as technical owner for controls, software, and system integration during project execution.
* Monitor engineering deliverables, interface milestones, approvals, testing plans, supplier actions, risks, deviations, change requests, and open points.
* Coordinate with customer IT/OT teams, equipment suppliers, software partners, global stakeholders, project managers, and site teams.
* Lead or support design reviews, FAT, interface testing, SAT, commissioning, ramp-up, performance testing, and handover.
* Ensure completeness of final documentation, source-code handover requirements, backups, licences, manuals, test records, and training deliverables.
* Localization & Capability Development
* Develop standard controls concepts, specifications, checklists, architectures, and BOMs for AWE projects in India.
* Support standardization of PLCs, drives, safety devices, sensors, panels, networking components, and field hardware.
* Drive localization, value engineering, cost optimization, make-or-buy assessments, and lessons learned for future projects.

title: Passive Technician
description:
We are seeking a skilled Passive Technician to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in network cabling, structured cabling, and fiber optic cable installation and maintenance. As a Passive Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, testing, and troubleshooting of passive network components, ensuring that all systems are functioning optimally and efficiently. Key Responsibilities: - Install and maintain structured cabling systems, including fiber optic and copper cabling. - Perform splicing and termination of fiber optic cables. - Conduct testing and troubleshooting of passive components to ensure compliance with industry standards. - Collaborate with project managers and other technicians to complete installations on time and within budget. - Maintain accurate documentation of installations and repairs. - Stay updated on the latest technologies and best practices in network cabling and passive components. Required Skills: - Proficiency in network cabling and structured cabling techniques. - Experience with fiber optic cable installation and splicing. - Knowledge of passive components and their applications in network systems. - Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for technology and a commitment to quality, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as a Passive Technician.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ahy Consulting is a progressive development agency specializing in eCommerce growth, backed by 17 years of industry experience. The team has witnessed and adapted to the evolution of the internet, building strategies that drive measurable results for clients. Since 2018, Ahy Consulting has achieved an average 35% increase in conversions within the first six months across its eCommerce support projects. Operational processes are designed to enable sustainable growth and scale, challenging both internal teams and business owners to reach ambitious goals. More information about the company and its services is available at www.ahyconsulting.com.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kalyan Dombivli. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating security controls into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The engineer will manage cloud and on\-premise infrastructure, automate deployments, monitor system performance, and ensure compliance with security best practices and standards. Daily tasks include collaborating with development and operations teams, performing vulnerability assessments, managing incident response, and improving tooling and processes for reliability, scalability, and security. The role also involves mentoring team members, documenting procedures, and contributing to architectural decisions that support eCommerce growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Proficiency in Back\-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining APIs and microservices.
* Advanced Programming skills in one or more languages commonly used in DevSecOps environments (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in secure, maintainable codebases.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Experience implementing security practices across the SDLC, including code scanning, dependency management, and container security.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux\-based systems administration.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, communicate clearly, and document processes and standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in eCommerce or high\-traffic web applications is an advantage; relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CSSLP) are a plus.
